name: TARENTULA CUBENSIS
key_symptoms: Dizziness after heat and hot perspiration. Dull ache on top of head. Shooting pain through left eye across frontal region.
Gastric.--Stomach feels hard, sore. Loss of appetite, except for breakfast.
guiding_symptoms: Dizziness after heat and hot perspiration. Dull ache on top of head. Shooting pain through left eye across frontal region.
Gastric.--Stomach feels hard, sore. Loss of appetite, except for breakfast.
head_symptoms: Dizziness after heat and hot perspiration. Dull ache on top of head. Shooting pain through left eye across frontal region.
Gastric.--Stomach feels hard, sore. Loss of appetite, except for breakfast.
urinary_symptoms: Retention. Cannot hold urine on coughing.
skin_symptoms: Red spots and pimples. Feels puffed all over. Carbuncles, burning, stinging pains. Purplish hue. Gangrene. Abscesses, where pain and inflammation predominate. Scirrhus of breasts. "Senile" ulcers.
sleep_symptoms: Drowsiness. Sleep restless. Sleep prevented by harsh cough.

source.title: TARENTULA CUBENSIS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
